Subject: Sprint‑Zero / Procurement kickoff — scheduling and attendee confirmation

Hi Teresa / BlueWave procurement team —

Thanks for the RFP intake — excited to get the vendor onboarding kickoff on the calendar. To make this meeting useful for everyone, we typically run a 60‑75 minute Sprint‑Zero kickoff that covers:
- Short platform demo (AE + SE)
- Data flow & privacy (SE + infra lead)
- Procurement intake & PO / contract touchpoints (sales + procurement)
- Security evidence checklist (SOC2, retention, audit logs)
- Next steps / pilot timeline and owner assignments

Can you confirm who from BlueWave should attend (procurement lead, security, engineering owner)? For scheduling, we have these windows next week:
- Wed, Sep 16 — 10:00–11:15 PT
- Wed, Sep 16 — 14:00–15:15 PT
- Thu, Sep 17 — 09:00–10:15 PT

I’ve attached a short Sprint‑Zero checklist and a vendor intake MOA for your prep. If the team prefers a different cadence or a shorter initial scoping call, we can compress to 30 minutes and schedule a follow up for a deeper technical session.

Proposed agenda attached. Please reply with attendee list and preferred time and we’ll send a calendar invite.

—
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0187

Attachments: sprint-zero-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), vendor-intake-MOA.pdf (PDF)
